inputs.text: This account turns one alleged case into an indictment of sanctuary policies, without giving enough information to assess what happened or whether local officials actually put the public at risk. It also treats immigration status as the central explanation, inviting people to blame immigrants rather than ask whether public-safety decisions were made fairly and effectively. Protecting people from harm matters, but so do due process and policies that let communities seek help without fear. One arrest should not become a reason to weaken those protections or expand federal enforcement unchecked.
